identifiers.name: Marktlokations-ID (MaLo-ID)
identifiers.description: The identifier of a market location of the German electricity or gas market, the point where energy is supplied or fed in and billed: eleven digits, the first naming the code-issuing body (4 to 9 for the electricity and water association's issuing service, 1 to 3 for the gas association's), nine digits issued by it, and a check digit computed by the locomotive and wagon numbering method. The network operator requests and assigns it; it does not change when the network operator changes, and it says nothing about the operator or the energy carrier.

identifiers.name: Amtlicher Gemeindeschlüssel (AGS)
identifiers.description: The eight-digit official key of a municipality in the statistics office's register: two digits of the state (01 to 16), one of the government district, two of the district, three of the municipality. It is not the postal code.

identifiers.name: MaStR-Nummer
identifiers.description: The number the core energy market data register (Marktstammdatenregister) gives a unit, a grouping or a market actor: three letters naming its kind (SEE a power generation unit, SEL a technical generation location, ABR a plant operator, SNB a power network operator…), the version digit 9, ten random digits and a check digit computed by the EAN method over the version and the ten digits; a market actor may carry two letters naming its market role.
